title: Training reward and informative groups
description: Raw training reward, reward/avg_pass_at_{n} and the fraction of informative groups. Compare sustained reward changes with held-out evaluation; an informative-group fraction near zero means most groups provide little relative training signal. Reward scales depend on the task, and pass-at-n depends on group size; requires trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No training-metric observations. Check trainer.training_metrics and the selected Job/Execution.
